'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[North Korea]] has sent 3,000 more [[Korean People's Army|soldiers]] to bolster Russia’s war on Ukraine, South Korea’s military says. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/03/27/europe/north-korea-russia-ukraine-soldiers-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN World)]
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[March 2025 Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip]]
****[[Hamas]] announces that an [[Israeli Defence Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] has killed Abdel Latif al-Qanou, who served as Hamas' spokesman. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/03/27/hamas-spokesperson-qanoua-killed-in-israeli-airstrike-hamas-media- (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***[[Israel]] intercepts two [[ballistic missile]]s launched by the [[Houthis]] from [[Yemen]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/sirens-sounded-israel-after-projectile-launched-yemen-military-says-2025-03-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**[[Gang war in Haiti]]
***A [[Kenya|Kenyan]] [[Kenya Police|police officer]] deployed in [[Haiti]] as part of the [[Multinational Security Support Mission]] is killed in a suspected gang ambush, according to Haitian authorities. Kenya has confirmed that the officer is missing but has not yet verified his death. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj0ql5yq167o (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
***[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Mark Carney]] says a 25% [[tariff]] on [[Automotive industry|automotive]] imports to the [[United States]] is a "direct attack" on his country by the [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] and vows to respond. [https://apnews.com/article/canada-carney-trump-trade-war-a1ed1bb3bb9d69cc4d88eaeabe3ac16b (AP)]
**[[Japan]] confirms it has asked the U.S. for an exemption from the new automotive tariffs, saying the 25% tariff on vehicle imports would have a massive negative impact on [[Automotive industry in Japan|its automotive industry]]. Japan is one of the largest exporters of cars to the United States. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2025/03/5d5b549dc5ca-update1-japan-vows-appropriate-steps-against-us-auto-tariffs.html (Kyodo News)]
*The United States suspends financial contributions to the [[World Trade Organization]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-suspends-financial-contributions-wto-trade-sources-say-2025-03-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[March 2025 South Korea wildfires]], [[List of landmarks destroyed or damaged by climate change|Landmarks destroyed by climate change]]
**Ongoing [[Climate change|climate-exacerbated]] [[Wildfire|wildfires]] in [[South Korea]] develop into the worst natural fire disaster in the nation's history after doubling in size over the course of 24 hours, killing at least 26 people and destroying much of the [[Silla|ancient]] [[Gounsa]] [[Buddhist temples in Korea|temple]] site. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/mar/27/south-korea-fires-death-toll-rises-worst-in-history?CMP=Share_AndroidApp_Other (''The Guardian'')] [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250327001953315 (Yonhap News)]
*[[2025 Red Sea tourist submarine disaster]]
**At least six people are killed and 39 others are rescued after a ''Sindbad'' [[submarine]] carrying [[Russia]]n [[Tourism in Egypt|tourists]] sinks off the [[Red Sea]] coast of [[Hurghada]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/clynd93449kt (BBC News)]
*Two people are killed, including [[alpine skiing|alpine skier]] [[Berkin Usta]], and four others are injured in a fire at a [[ski resort]] in [[Uludağ]], [[Turkey]]. [https://metro.co.uk/2025/03/27/olympic-skier-25-father-killed-fire-abandoned-ski-resort-hotel-22805146 (''Metro'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*British [[environmental activist]] group [[Just Stop Oil]] announces they will end all [[civil resistance]], [[direct action]], and [[vandalism]]-related protests immediately and disband by April 26 after the [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] announced it will halt the granting of new [[petroleum industry|oil and gas]] permits. [https://www.dw.com/en/just-stop-oil-to-end-disruptive-climate-protests/a-72057363 (DW)] [https://www.gov.uk/government/consultations/building-the-north-seas-energy-future/building-the-north-seas-energy-future-consultation-document-accessible-webpage (Government of the United Kingdom)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] announces that they have expanded sanctions against [[Belarus]] to include the [[Central Election Commission of Belarus]] for [[political repression]] in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/eu-expands-sanctions-against-belarus-over-political-oppression-2025-03-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Amsterdam stabbing attack]]
**Five people are wounded in a [[mass stabbing]] at [[Dam Square]] in [[Amsterdam]], [[Netherlands]]. The suspect, 30-year-old [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] citizen from [[Donetsk]] is arrested by [[National Police Corps (Netherlands)|police]], and is being investigated with having a terrorist motive. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/several-people-wounded-stabbing-near-amsterdams-dam-square-2025-03-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Proposed secession of Republika Srpska]]
**The [[Government of Bosnia and Herzegovina|government]] of [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] issues an international [[arrest warrant]] for [[Milorad Dodik]], the [[President of Republika Srpska|president]] of [[Republika Srpska]], an [[Political divisions of Bosnia and Herzegovina|entity]] of Bosnia and Herzegovina, accusing him of repeatedly taking actions that could violate the [[Dayton Agreement|Dayton Accords]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/bosnia-issues-international-arrest-warrant-for-milorad-dodik/a-72060737 (DW)] [https://apnews.com/article/bosnia-serbs-dodik-arrest-warrant-a275f3ca18b5e157af31eaabb6ea92a3 (AP)]
*[[South Sudan]]ese [[Vice President of South Sudan|vice president]] [[Riek Machar]] is detained by [[South Sudan People's Defence Forces|security forces]] following an [[arrest warrant]] on "unclear charges", according to his spokesperson. The [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement-in-Opposition]] says Machar's arrest has effectively ended the 2018 peace agreement which ended the [[South Sudanese Civil War|civil war]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/south-sudan-opposition-leader-riek-machar-detained-amid-warnings-of-renewed-civil-war-in-worlds-youngest-country-13336474 (Sky News)]
*[[Crime in Peru]]
**The home of Luis Villanueva, leader of the [[Confederación General de Trabajadores del Perú|Workers' General Confederation of Peru]] (CGTP), is damaged by an explosive device. Business associations condemned the attack and increased demands on the government to strengthen the fight against [[organized crime]]. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20250328/10527369/maximo-lider-sindical-peru-sufre-ataque-explosivos-casa-agenciaslv20250328.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
